Name: StarAmy's Bakery Displays 1.6 for FF
Author: Ashrayne
Description:
[i][size=4]Presenting: StarAmy's [/size][/i][size=4][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14229/]Bakery Displays[/url] , ported to Furniture Framework (FF) for full compatibility with SDV 1.6.

[b]Features:[/b][/i][/size]
[list]
[*]15 functional wall or freestanding shelves and bakery display cases purchasable from Robin's shop. 
[*]The freestanding pieces can be placed both indoors and outdoors.
[*]Up to nine objects can be placed on the shelves, including any modded objects!
[*]Access this mod's furniture set from StarAmy's furniture catalogue if you have that installed (HIGHLY RECOMMENDED)
[*]FF is planning compatibility with Market Town in a future update so NPCs will purchase right out of the display cases!
[/list][i][size=3][b]Why this mod exists:[/b][/size]
Furniture Display Framework originally by Aedenthorn did not survive the transition to 1.6 terribly well. Among other things, it currently suffers from a complete inability to display any modded object sprite correctly. If you're anything like me and love decorating, being restricted to only displaying vanilla objects in a cute store is a total non-starter. Thankfully, we now have an alternative: [/i][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458/]Furniture Framework[/url] by Leroymilo!
[/i]
[size=4][i][b]Recommended Pairings[/b]:[/i][/size]
[list]
[*]Create a beautiful bakery with StarAmy's display cases in tandem with Himetarts & Wildflour's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9991/]H&W's Bakery and Cafe Furniture[/url] (also pictured in the screenshots).
[*]Himetarts & Wildflour's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23561/]Freshly Baked[/url]
[*]Lavliette's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24297/]Wafflemania[/url] (pictured in front center display)
[*]Lavliette's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24695/]Lovely Fruitpudding[/url] (pictured in front left display)
[/list]
This set is intended as an alternative to the FDF set, aka please don't install both (I mean, you technically could but why would you want to?). I'm also not kidding about highly recommending using StarAmy's furniture catalogue as FF is currently not compatible with AT, so all of the color variants for each piece are added individually to the shop menu. This mod adds over 100 entries to Robin's shop menu without the furniture catalogue installed and makes it incredibly busy to scroll through![list]
[/list]
